description: This file defines the Group class, which extends the User class, overriding attributes and methods related to group management within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for marking a group as deleted and creating export queries, with access control checks.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: A class representing a user group, extending the User class, with specific attributes and methods for group management.

methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent User class constructor.

methods.description: Creates an SQL query to export user data, with admin check.
